scope: Android app screens and adaptive layout (b1-b6), device smoke tests, scan-throttling documentation, two-way parity control, signing secrets removed from source, 1.5.0 release APK staged for GitHub with a user install guide

hypothesis.claim: With the core proven by parity fixtures, the Compose app plus an adaptive layout gives a usable tablet survey tool, and the release can ship without any secret in the repository
hypothesis.disconfirming_result: Device smoke test shows cut-off or unusable controls, or the release APK cannot be signed without committed secrets

options: Slide-over network list (B) with three panes only on large screens
decision.chosen: Slide-over network list (B) with three panes only on large screens
decision.why: Owner approved the merge after the C-12 graded proposal; spectrum stays visible while selecting

change.summary: Real Wi-Fi app replacing the preview; adaptive layout; right-side network slide-over (multi-select, closes on CLOSE or outside tap, pinned row order); signing secrets moved to local.properties; build_android_release.py; INSTALL_GUIDE.md; WIFI_SCAN_THROTTLING.md; DR-0017; mirror includes AndroidApp source and the ANDROID APK folder
change.scope_authority: Owner 2026-10-19: implement the actual app; approve the merge layout; remove the password and upload to standard

positive: multi-select keeps the list open; tap outside closes it
row order held across two rescans
release APK byte-identical to b6, same signer as all earlier builds
negative: no keystore, APK build output or local-only screenshots in the mirror
only synthetic MAC addresses in Android sources

what_worked: Device gate with read-back hash and screenshots
Reproducible release build (identical bytes to the tested build)
what_failed: Auto-close on selection blocked multi-select (reverted on owner feedback)
Rows re-sorted under the finger on each rescan (fixed by pinning)
Scan requests every 5 s while throttled (open, T30-WP2)
residual_risk: Portrait and full-feature smoke test not finished
Windows back-fill of the Android layout changes (T31)

reuse.reuse_applied: build_release.py pattern for the APK folder; reference sideload lessons

lessons.transferable_rule: Keep signing secrets out of source from the first build, and ship user install instructions next to the binary
